source: FIGURES.md adapted from people to clubs, 2026-09-22, tool switch in effect: search demand from Google Ads Keyword Planner and live Google search rather than Ahrefs (KEYWORD-METHOD.md). S1 search demand; S4 the consensus lists actually read (RA's 2026 guide, Tripadvisor's 15 Best, barcelona-life, barcelona.com, read only as aggregate web-search snippets, not each list in full); S5 history (Wikipedia and trade press for Razzmatazz and Zeleste; Sala Apolo's own site, Primavera Sound's retrospective and The New Barcelona Post for Sala Apolo/Nitsa; Resident Advisor's own feature and Barcelona Tourist Guide for Macarena Club). Rule: required means 3+ sources or S5 at all.
